# iosxe_controller (Data Source)

This data source can read the Controller configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_controller" "example" {
  type   = "T1"
  number = "0/1/0"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `number` (String)
- `type` (String)

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `e1_framing` (String)
- `framing` (String)
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `pri_group_timeslots` (String) List of timeslots in the pri-group
